description: Implementation of the Scheduler class for Android SurfaceFlinger, managing display refresh rates, Vsync, timers, and display modes.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Manages display synchronization, refresh rates, timers, and display modes for Android SurfaceFlinger.

methods.name: startTimers
methods.description: Initializes touch and display power timers based on system properties.

methods.name: setPacesetterDisplay
methods.description: Sets the display that controls the refresh rate policy.

methods.name: registerDisplay
methods.description: Registers a new display with its refresh rate selector.

methods.name: unregisterDisplay
methods.description: Removes a display from management.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop processing messages.

methods.name: onFrameSignal
methods.description: Handles a new frame signal, commits and composites frames.

methods.name: getFrameRateOverride
methods.description: Retrieves frame rate override for a given UID.

methods.name: isVsyncValid
methods.description: Checks if a Vsync timestamp is valid for a UID.

methods.name: isVsyncInPhase
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is in phase with the Vsync schedule.

methods.name: makeThrottleVsyncCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback to throttle Vsync based on validity.

methods.name: makeGetVsyncPeriodFunction
methods.description: Creates a function to get Vsync period for a UID.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates an event thread for a cycle with timing parameters.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a connection handle for an event thread.

methods.name: createConnectionInternal
methods.description: Internal method to create a connection with optional layer handle.

methods.name: createDisplayEventConnection
methods.description: Creates a display event connection for a handle.

methods.name: getEventConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the event connection for a handle.

methods.name: onHotplugReceived
methods.description: Handles hotplug events for displays.

methods.name: enableSyntheticVsync
methods.description: Enables or disables synthetic Vsync.

methods.name: onFrameRateOverridesChanged
methods.description: Updates frame rate overrides for a display.

methods.name: onPrimaryDisplayModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to primary display mode.

methods.name: dispatchCachedReportedMode
methods.description: Dispatches cached display mode if changed.

methods.name: onNonPrimaryDisplayModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to non-primary display modes.

methods.name: getEventThreadConnectionCount
methods.description: Returns the number of connections for an event thread handle.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal state for debugging.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets work and ready durations for a connection handle.

methods.name: setVsyncConfigSet
methods.description: Configures Vsync settings for the modulator.

methods.name: setVsyncConfig
methods.description: Sets Vsync configuration and durations.

methods.name: enableHardwareVsync
methods.description: Enables hardware Vsync for a display.

methods.name: disableHardwareVsync
methods.description: Disables hardware Vsync for a display.

methods.name: resyncAllToHardwareVsync
methods.description: Resynchronizes all displays to hardware Vsync.

methods.name: resyncToHardwareVsyncLocked
methods.description: Resyncs a specific display to hardware Vsync with optional refresh rate.

methods.name: setRenderRate
methods.description: Sets the render rate for a display.

methods.name: resync
methods.description: Performs a resync if last resync was sufficiently long ago.

methods.name: addResyncSample
methods.description: Adds a resync sample for a display.

methods.name: addPresentFence
methods.description: Adds a present fence to a display's schedule.

methods.name: registerLayer
methods.description: Registers a layer for history tracking.

methods.name: deregisterLayer
methods.description: Deregisters a layer.

methods.name: recordLayerHistory
methods.description: Records a layer's state change.

methods.name: setModeChangePending
methods.description: Marks a mode change as pending.

methods.name: setDefaultFrameRateCompatibility
methods.description: Sets default frame rate compatibility for a layer.

methods.name: chooseRefreshRateForContent
methods.description: Selects refresh rate based on content analysis.

methods.name: resetIdleTimer
methods.description: Resets the idle timer.

methods.name: onTouchHint
methods.description: Handles touch hint events to boost performance.

methods.name: setDisplayPowerMode
methods.description: Sets power mode for a display.

methods.name: getVsyncSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves Vsync schedule for a display.

methods.name: getVsyncScheduleLocked
methods.description: Internal method to get Vsync schedule with lock.

methods.name: kernelIdleTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback for kernel idle timer expiration.

methods.name: idleTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback for idle timer expiration.

methods.name: touchTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback for touch timer expiration.

methods.name: displayPowerTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback for display power timer expiration.

methods.name: dumpVsync
methods.description: Outputs Vsync schedule info.

methods.name: updateFrameRateOverrides
methods.description: Updates frame rate overrides based on signals.

methods.name: promotePacesetterDisplay
methods.description: Sets a display as the pacesetter for refresh rate control.

methods.name: promotePacesetterDisplayLocked
methods.description: Internal method to promote a display as pacesetter.

methods.description: Applies a new Vsync schedule to all relevant threads.

methods.name: demotePacesetterDisplay
methods.description: Clears the pacesetter display state.

methods.name: applyPolicy
methods.description: Applies a policy change and updates display modes and overrides.

methods.name: chooseDisplayModes
methods.description: Selects display modes for all displays based on current signals.

methods.name: makeGlobalSignals
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of global signals affecting display refresh.

methods.name: getPreferredDisplayMode
methods.description: Returns the preferred display mode based on current policies.

methods.name: onNewVsyncPeriodChangeTimeline
methods.description: Handles updates to Vsync period change timelines.

methods.name: onPostComposition
methods.description: Handles post-composition logic related to Vsync timeline.

methods.name: onActiveDisplayAreaChanged
methods.description: Updates display area info for layer history.

methods.description: Sets refresh rate override for game mode for a UID.
